name: game-music-companion-platform
description: Full-stack game and music companion platform that recommends playlists from game, mood, and session context.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
